description:
Housing, fire and nuisance inspections at or near an address, by year, including inspections still open. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "Does 3300 Chicago Ave, Minneapolis have open code violations?"
- "How many housing inspections were near this block in 2025?"

address.description: A street address in the seven-county Minneapolis-St. Paul metro, city after a comma. Omit for the market-wide count.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: code_violations_at_address
title: Code Violations at an Address
